svg.text: from above, front of the robot at the bottom
from the right of the front view, robot front on the left
for reference only, not to scale, do not measure
Third-angle projection: each view is drawn on the side
you look from. Top view sits above the front view,
right side view sits to the right of it.
Views line up: a width in the front view continues
straight up into the top view, a height continues
straight across into the side view (dotted guides).
Hidden edges are left out to keep it readable.
Red marks the camera, tilt axis, centre and axle lines.
Rough guideline from v2/cad/step/dimer_v2_guideline_assembly.step. Part sizes are typical seller dimensions: measure real parts before final fits.
